item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Gameplay, Release Window, and Roster Details
item.description: Vampire hunting is back on the schedule. Konami finally handed the keys to their most neglected property over to Evil Empire and Motion Twin, the exact development duo who made the Return to Castlevania DLC so fantastic it practically demanded a standalone title.

item.title: Professor Layton and The New World of Steam: 2026 Release, PS5 Expansion, and Story Details Explained
item.description: Level-5 officially confirmed Professor Layton and The New World of Steam will launch globally in 2026 across the Nintendo Switch, the Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam.

item.title: Jam Kuradoberi Joins Guilty Gear -Strive-: Starter Guide Breakdown & Season 5 Launch
item.description: Arc System Works dropped the official Jam Kuradoberi starter guide ahead of the highly anticipated Guilty Gear -Strive- Season 5.
